SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.
   B. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   C. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

5. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
   D. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   B. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.
   C. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   B. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.
   D. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Vegetation in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

11. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   B. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Language groups in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
